# Dependencies without generated-code identity

These are bindings for `fleet.common` from `../rev_a/configuration.brd`. They were generated by the schema compiler at `351a89e`, the last compiler before generated-code identity (#111 G1). They carry the A4.2 configuration identity (`schema_id` macros, `quarry_cfg_<schema_id>`) but no generated-code identity.

Tests copy each file to its name without the `.pre_generated_code_identity` suffix. They then check that bindings from the current compiler that depend on it fail with the "predates generated-code identity" diagnostic. That diagnostic follows the A4.2 configuration checks, which this file still passes.

The suffix keeps formatting hooks from rewriting genuine generator output. Don't regenerate these files with a newer compiler.
